nodes.name: When Executed by Another Workflow
nodes.notes: Private sub-workflow. Inputs: report_id (UUID), revision (positive integer), dataset (live|demo), trace_id (non-empty string).

nodes.name: Settings and Validation
nodes.notes: Only configuration in this workflow: Supabase Project URL. Bind SLA Guard - Supabase Header Auth (apikey) on the two HTTP nodes.

nodes.name: Request Valid?
nodes.notes: Outputs: 0 continue; 1 Return Error. Invalid input never calls Supabase.

nodes.name: Load Saved Report
nodes.notes: Select SLA Guard - Supabase Header Auth (apikey). Full response keeps an empty array in the body.

nodes.name: Save Claim Draft
nodes.notes: Select SLA Guard - Supabase Header Auth (apikey). PATCH only claim_draft; revision filter rejects a newer row.

parameters.content:
## SLA Guard 05 | Claim Draft
Private sub-workflow. Keep inactive until team assembly.
1. Set Project URL in Settings and Validation.
2. Bind SLA Guard - Supabase (Header Auth, apikey) on Load Saved Report and Save Claim Draft.
3. Give this workflow ID to Sherif (04).
Reads saved SLA numbers only. First line of the draft is SLA GUARD CLAIM DRAFT.
